sections.title: Aaronic Blessing in Paleo-Hebrew
paragraphs: ye·va·rekh·kha YHVH ve·yish·me·re·kha ya·er YHVH HE will bless you YHVH and HE will keep you HE will cause to shine YHVH pa·naw e·le·kha vee·chun·ne·ka yis·sa YHVH His face upon you and HE will be gracious to you HE will lift up YHVH pa·naw e·le·kha ve·ya·sem le·kha sha·lom His countenance upon you and HE will give to you peace YHVH’s Blessing for the Children of Israel “And THE LORD spake unto Moses, saying, Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them, ‘THE LORD bless thee, and keep thee: THE LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: THE LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.’ And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.” Numbers 6:22-27 KJV
